title: Nuggety French Potato Polish Skillet
description: A gluten-free friendly, fermented, shattering, nostalgic Polish dish featuring small potatoes in a mirepoix-base for a perfect side or meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add unsalted butter and mirepoix to the pan, cooking until they soften, stirring occasionally.
Add thinly sliced onions and garlic cloves. Cook for about 5 minutes, ensuring the onions are translucent.
Slice small potatoes into rounds or cubes that will fit in your skillet without overcrowding. Add them to the skillet with peas (if using).
Stir everything together thoroughly until all ingredients are coated with mirepoix base and evenly distributed.
Reduce heat to low, cover the skillet, and let it cook for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender and slightly caramelized on the edges.
Serve hot as a side dish or main meal. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
